en.title: Flexport OA #3: Sum of All Values
en.description: Given a string num consisting only of the digits 0-9. You may insert one '+' between any two adjacent characters; adjacent '+' signs are not allowed, and you may also insert none at all. Each way of inserting produces an expression, and each segment separated by '+' is evaluated as a decimal integer (leading zeros do not affect the value; for example, 05 has value 5). Find the sum of the values of all possible expressions, modulo 10^9+7.
en.input: A single line containing the string num. 1≤|num|≤3×10^7, containing only the characters 0-9.
en.output: Output one integer: the sum of the values of all expressions modulo 10^9+7.
en.explanation: Example 1: the expressions for "123" are 1+23=24, 12+3=15, 1+2+3=6, and 123=123, for a total of 168. Example 2: the expressions for "105" are 105, 1+05=6, 10+5=15, and 1+0+5=6, for a total of 132. Example 3: "7" has only one expression, with value 7.
hints: Add the digits one at a time: each old expression either gets a '+' before the new digit, or the digit is appended to its last segment.
Maintain three quantities: the number of expressions, the sum of their values, and the sum of their last-segment values.
